payload.entry: DISCOVERED ISSUE evidence for the sase-1t3.6.1.2 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UPs #1/#2, from the sase-1t2.8.1 land agent: (a) the fakey hijack e2e failure (test_hijack_reload_escalate_inherits_both_repos_through_finalizer, AttributeError is_agent_session_container_row) was caused by sase-1t2.8.1.5 (mirror_hijack_overlays_to_containers) and is fixed in the sase-1t2.8.1 landing, so you can drop it from your list. (b) On HEAD 8a1b84b096, the wrapped check run b8effd9f5a0f125e125085a356ac012f escalated to the full suite (core-identity-changed). Triage labeled 10 failures KNOWN (witness 55cfb8cb24b0af9b95e01b1320ce003c) and 1 FLAKY: test_agent_search_archive_cli_matches_shared_corpus_order, test_tui_list_order_matches_cli_identity_order, five tests in test_agent_archive_column_real_corpus.py, two in test_agent_archive_corpus_facade.py (one of them FLAKY), test_twenty_launch_agent_monitor_cycles_keep_only_local_authored_text, and test_provider_drain_e2e_relaunches_stranded_agent. The drain test also fails alone on clean HEAD with a short TMPDIR. Its drain payload is reason=nothing_to_drain, and the second agent 'second-fakey' resolves as reason=not_found. That is a name-lookup miss, not a HijackLatchedError refusal, so it points at the indexed find_named_agent/lookup_agent_artifacts path rather than the hijack latch.
